title: GET /links returns one item fewer than the limit
body:
### What is wrong or missing

Listing links with `?limit=2` when 3 links exist returns only 1 item.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`GET /links?limit=2` returns exactly 2 items when at least 2 links exist.

### How to reproduce

Create 3 links, then `GET /links?limit=2`. See `src/pagination.ts`.

title: Slug validation accepts uppercase, empty and over-long slugs
body:
### What is wrong or missing

`isValidSlug` accepts `MyLink`, the empty string and a 100-character slug.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`isValidSlug` returns true only for 3–32 characters of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, as docs/API.md states.

### How to reproduce

See `src/validation.ts`.

title: Creating a duplicate slug returns 500 instead of 409
body:
### What is wrong or missing

POSTing a slug that already exists throws, and the server answers 500.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

A second `POST /links` with an existing slug returns status 409 with a JSON error body.

title: Expired links still redirect
body:
### What is wrong or missing

A link created with `ttlSeconds` keeps redirecting after it expires.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`GET /r/<slug>` returns 404 once the link's expiry time has passed (use the store's injectable clock in the test).

### How to reproduce

See `LinkStore.resolve` in `src/store.ts`.

title: Redirects do not count clicks
body:
### What is wrong or missing

Following `GET /r/<slug>` leaves the link's `clicks` at 0.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

Each successful `GET /r/<slug>` increments that link's `clicks` by 1 (visible via `GET /links/<slug>`).

title: javascript: URLs are accepted as link targets
body:
### What is wrong or missing

`isValidUrl('javascript:alert(1)')` returns true, so unsafe targets can be stored.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`isValidUrl` returns true only for absolute `http:` and `https:` URLs; `javascript:`, `data:` and `ftp:` are rejected.

title: The limit query parameter is not capped at 100
body:
### What is wrong or missing

`GET /links?limit=1000` uses a page size of 1000.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`parsePaging` caps `limit` at `MAX_LIMIT` (100); `?limit=1000` yields limit 100.

title: GET /links is not sorted newest first
body:
### What is wrong or missing

Links are listed in insertion order, but docs/API.md and the `list()` comment say newest first.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`GET /links` returns items ordered by `createdAt` descending (newest first).

title: GET /stats returns NaN average with no links
body:
### What is wrong or missing

With an empty store, `averageClicks` is `NaN` (serialized as `null`).

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`computeStats([])` returns `averageClicks: 0`, as docs/API.md states.

title: Error responses lack the JSON content-type header
body:
### What is wrong or missing

Error responses (400, 404) have no `content-type` header although the body is JSON.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

Every error response from the handler includes `content-type: application/json`.

title: GET /links/ with a trailing slash returns 404
body:
### What is wrong or missing

`GET /links/` returns 404 while `GET /links` works.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`GET /links/` behaves exactly like `GET /links`.

title: DELETE /links/:slug should return 204 with no body
body:
### What is wrong or missing

Deleting a link returns 200 with `{"deleted": true}`.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

A successful `DELETE /links/<slug>` returns status 204 and an empty body; unknown slugs still return 404.

title: Target URLs longer than 2048 characters are accepted
body:
### What is wrong or missing

docs/API.md limits targets to 2048 characters, but longer URLs are stored.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`POST /links` with a target longer than 2048 characters returns 400.

title: README states the wrong default port
body:
### What is wrong or missing

README.md says the server listens on port 3000; `src/server.ts` uses 8080.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

README.md states the default port 8080 and the `PORT` override.

title: Fix spelling mistakes in docs/API.md
body:
### What is wrong or missing

docs/API.md contains misspellings such as "recieve" and "seperate".

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

docs/API.md has no misspellings of "receive" and "separate"; no other content changes.

title: Document DELETE /links/:slug in docs/API.md
body:
### What is wrong or missing

The API reference does not describe the delete endpoint.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

docs/API.md has a `DELETE /links/:slug` section describing the success and 404 responses as currently implemented.

title: Add unit tests for computeStats
body:
### What is wrong or missing

`src/stats.ts` has no direct tests.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

A new test file `test/stats.test.ts` covers `computeStats` for a non-empty list (totals and average). Do not change `src/stats.ts`.

title: Add a GET /health endpoint
body:
### What is wrong or missing

There is no endpoint for liveness checks.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`GET /health` returns 200 with body `{"status":"ok"}` and the JSON content-type.

title: Support filtering GET /links by target substring
body:
### What is wrong or missing

There is no way to find links pointing at a domain.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`GET /links?q=example` returns only links whose target contains `example` (case-insensitive); paging applies after filtering.

title: Invalid JSON in POST /links returns 500 instead of 400
body:
### What is wrong or missing

A request body that is not valid JSON makes the handler throw.

### Expected behavior (the done condition)

`POST /links` with an invalid JSON body returns 400 with a JSON error body.
